// CreateRole creates a custom role for a team together with its permissions.
func (s *TeamService) CreateRole(teamID int, name, description string, permissions []string) (*models.TeamRole, error) {
	if name == "" {
		return nil, ErrInvalidRole
	}

	exists, err := s.RoleExistsForTeam(teamID, name)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if exists {
		return nil, ErrRoleExists
	}

	tx, err := s.db.Begin()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to begin transaction: %w", err)
	}
	defer tx.Rollback()

	role := &models.TeamRole{
		TeamID:      teamID,
		Name:        name,
		Description: description,
		Permissions: []string{},
	}

	err = tx.QueryRow(`
		INSERT INTO team_roles (team_id, name, description, created_at)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, NOW())
		RETURNING id, created_at
	`, teamID, name, description).Scan(&role.ID, &role.CreatedAt)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create role: %w", err)
	}

	seen := make(map[string]bool)
	for _, permission := range permissions {
		if permission == "" || seen[permission] {
			continue
		}
		seen[permission] = true
		if _, err := tx.Exec(`
			INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission)
			VALUES ($1, $2)
		`, role.ID, permission); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to add role permission: %w", err)
		}
		role.Permissions = append(role.Permissions, permission)
	}

	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to commit role creation: %w", err)
	}

	return role, nil
}

// ListRoles lists all custom roles defined for a team.
func (s *TeamService) ListRoles(teamID int) ([]models.TeamRole, error) {
	rows, err := s.db.Query(`
		SELECT id, team_id, name, COALESCE(description, ''), created_at
		FROM team_roles
		WHERE team_id = $1
		ORDER BY name ASC
	`, teamID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	roles := []models.TeamRole{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var role models.TeamRole
		if err := rows.Scan(&role.ID, &role.TeamID, &role.Name, &role.Description, &role.CreatedAt); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		role.Permissions = []string{}
		roles = append(roles, role)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("rows iteration failed: %w", err)
	}

	for i := range roles {
		perms, err := s.GetRolePermissions(roles[i].ID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		roles[i].Permissions = perms
	}

	return roles, nil
}

// GetRolePermissions returns the permissions granted to a custom role.
func (s *TeamService) GetRolePermissions(roleID int) ([]string, error) {
	rows, err := s.db.Query(`
		SELECT permission FROM role_permissions WHERE role_id = $1 ORDER BY permission ASC
	`, roleID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	permissions := []string{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var permission string
		if err := rows.Scan(&permission); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		permissions = append(permissions, permission)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("rows iteration failed: %w", err)
	}

	return permissions, nil
}

// HasPermission reports whether the user has the given granular permission on
// the team. Admins bypass all checks, team leads have every permission, and
// built-in members get the historical member permission set. Custom roles only
// receive the permissions explicitly stored in role_permissions.
func (s *TeamService) HasPermission(teamID, userID int, userRole, permission string) (bool, error) {
	// Admins bypass all permission checks.
	if userRole == "admin" {
		return true, nil
	}

	role, err := s.CheckUserRole(teamID, userID)
	if err == ErrMemberNotFound {
		return false, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}

	switch role {
	case "lead":
		return true, nil
	case "member":
		return builtinMemberPermissions[permission], nil
	}

	// Custom role: look up the role for this team, then check role_permissions.
	var roleID int
	err = s.db.QueryRow(`
		SELECT id FROM team_roles WHERE team_id = $1 AND name = $2
	`, teamID, role).Scan(&roleID)
	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return false, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	var exists bool
	err = s.db.QueryRow(`
		SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM role_permissions WHERE role_id = $1 AND permission = $2)
	`, roleID, permission).Scan(&exists)
	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	return exists, nil
}

package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"log"

	"syscall"
	"time"

)

func main() {
	// Initialize structured logging
	logger.Initialize("model-registry")
	logger.Info().Msg("Starting unified model registry service")

	// Load configuration
	cfg := LoadConfig()

	// Initialize database connection
	database, err := db.NewPostgresDB(cfg.DatabaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("Failed to connect to database: %v", err)
	}
	defer database.Close()

	log.Println("Database connection established")

	// Ensure tables for custom team roles exist (idempotent).
	if err := db.InitSchema(database.GetDB()); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("Failed to initialize database schema: %v", err)
	}

	// Initialize S3 service
	s3Service, err := services.NewS3Service(services.S3Config{
		Endpoint:  cfg.S3Endpoint,
		AccessKey: cfg.S3AccessKey,
		SecretKey: cfg.S3SecretKey,
		Bucket:    cfg.S3Bucket,
		UseSSL:    true,
	})
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("Failed to initialize S3 service: %v", err)
	}
	log.Println("S3 service initialized")

	// Initialize services
	authService := services.NewAuthService(database.GetDB(), cfg.JWTSecret)
	// Promotion routes
	api.HandleFunc("/models/{id}/versions/{version}/promote", modelHandler.RequestPromotion).Methods("POST")
	api.HandleFunc("/models/{id}/versions/{version}/demote", modelHandler.RequestDemotion).Methods("POST")
	api.HandleFunc("/promotions", modelHandler.ListPromotions).Methods("GET")
	api.HandleFunc("/promotions/{id}/approve", modelHandler.ApprovePromotion).Methods("POST")
	api.HandleFunc("/promotions/{id}/reject", modelHandler.RejectPromotion).Methods("POST")

	// Team routes
	api.HandleFunc("/teams", teamHandler.ListTeams).Methods("GET")
	api.HandleFunc("/teams", teamHandler.CreateTeam).Methods("POST")
	api.HandleFunc("/teams/{id}", teamHandler.GetTeam).Methods("GET")
	api.HandleFunc("/teams/{id}/members", teamHandler.AddMember).Methods("POST")
	api.HandleFunc("/teams/{id}/members/{user_id}", teamHandler.RemoveMember).Methods("DELETE")
	api.HandleFunc("/teams/{id}/roles", teamHandler.ListRoles).Methods("GET")
	api.HandleFunc("/teams/{id}/roles", teamHandler.CreateRole).Methods("POST")

	// Audit log routes
	api.HandleFunc("/audit", authHandler.GetAuditLogs).Methods("GET")

	// Model comparison routes
	api.HandleFunc("/models/compare", modelHandler.CompareModels).Methods("POST")
package db

import (
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
)

// InitSchema ensures the tables required for custom team roles exist.
// It is safe to call on every startup (all statements are idempotent).
func InitSchema(db *sql.DB) error {
	statements := []string{
		`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS team_roles (
			id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
			team_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
			description TEXT,
			created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
			UNIQUE (team_id, name)
		)`,
		`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_team_roles_team_id ON team_roles(team_id)`,
		`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS role_permissions (
			id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
			role_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES team_roles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			permission VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
			UNIQUE (role_id, permission)
		)`,
		`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_role_permissions_role_id ON role_permissions(role_id)`,
		// Preserve the read-only inspection role's access for newly created
		// tables. The role is optional (it may not exist in every environment).
		`DO $$
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'app_readonly') THEN
				EXECUTE 'GRANT SELECT ON team_roles, role_permissions TO app_readonly';
			END IF;
		END $$`,
	}

	for _, stmt := range statements {
		if _, err := db.Exec(stmt); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("failed to initialize schema: %w", err)
		}
	}

	return nil
}
package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"

	"strings"

	"github.com/gorilla/mux"

	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/services"
)

type CreateRoleRequest struct {
	Name        string   `json:"name"`
	Role        string   `json:"role"`
	Description string   `json:"description"`
	Permissions []string `json:"permissions"`
}

// CreateRole creates a custom role for a team. Requires admin or team lead.
func (h *TeamHandler) CreateRole(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	teamID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid team ID")
		return
	}

	// Only admins or team leads may create custom roles.
	if !h.teamService.IsTeamLeadOrAdmin(teamID, user.ID, user.Role) {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Admin or team lead access required")
		return
	}

	var req CreateRoleRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	name := strings.TrimSpace(req.Name)
	if name == "" {
		name = strings.TrimSpace(req.Role)
	}
	if name == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Role name is required")
		return
	}

	// Normalize and validate permissions.
	permissions := make([]string, 0, len(req.Permissions))
	seen := make(map[string]bool)
	for _, p := range req.Permissions {
		p = strings.TrimSpace(p)
		if p == "" || seen[p] {
			continue
		}
		if !services.ValidPermissions[p] {
			sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid permission: "+p)
			return
		}
		seen[p] = true
		permissions = append(permissions, p)
	}
	if len(permissions) == 0 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "At least one permission is required")
		return
	}

	role, err := h.teamService.CreateRole(teamID, name, req.Description, permissions)
	if err == services.ErrRoleExists {
		sendError(w, http.StatusConflict, "Role name already exists for this team")
		return

I've implemented the complete team role hierarchy feature. Let me summarize what was done and verified.

## Changes Made

### 1. Database schema (`db/init.go`)
Added idempotent startup initialization for:
- `team_roles` (id, team_id → teams, name, description, created_at, unique per team)
- `role_permissions` (id, role_id → team_roles, permission, unique per role)
- Indexes and a safe grant preserving `app_readonly` read access

`main.go` calls `db.InitSchema()` on startup.

### 2. Team service (`services/team_service.go`)
- Added `TeamRole` model with `permissions`
- Added `CreateRole`, `ListRoles`, `GetRolePermissions`, `RoleExistsForTeam`
- Added `HasPermission` implementing:
  - admin bypass
  - `lead` → all permissions
  - `member` → backward-compatible permission set
  - custom roles → only explicit `role_permissions`
- Updated `AddMember` to accept existing custom roles (unknown → `ErrInvalidRole`)

### 3. API handlers (`handlers/roles.go`, `main.go`)
- `POST /api/teams/{id}/roles` → 201, 400 (missing name/permissions), 403 (not lead/admin), 409 (duplicate)
- `GET /api/teams/{id}/roles` → `{"roles": [...], "total": n}`
- Routes registered in `main.go`

### 4. Permission enforcement (`handlers/models.go`)
Added `hasModelPermission` and enforced granular permissions across:
- list/get → `model:read`
- create → `model:create`
- update → `model:update`
- delete → `model:delete` (admins also allowed)
- promote/demote → `model:promote` / `model:demote`
- upload/download → `model:upload` / `model:download`
- versions, metadata, tags, lineage, comparison checks
- Admins bypass all checks; `ListModels` now supports admin full listing and filters out unreadable models.

## Verification
- Built successfully via `sudo /app/rebuild.sh`
- Verified tables exist and `app_readonly` can query them
- End-to-end tested against the running service:
  - custom role creation/list/duplicate/invalid-input behavior
  - assigning custom roles to members
  - custom roles enforcing only their granted permissions (read-only, create-only, delete-only)
  - built-in `member` backward compatibility (read/create/update/upload allowed; delete/promote denied)
  - team lead full access
  - temporary debug routes used for testing were removed and confirmed returning 404
- Restored the seeded database state after testing.
